sn50.1-12:1.1: As seen in [sn48.43](), the five powers are almost identical to the five spiritual faculties. Though theoretically consisting of 108 discourses, the Saṁyutta on the powers consists almost entirely of stock passages and abbreviations. The analysis lacking here is found in a series of Suttas at [an5.13]()–16. | The Chinese version of this collection, representing the Sarvāstivāda Balasaṁyukta, has a substantial collection of texts, gathering together many of the discourses on different sets of “powers” that in the Pali are scattered about the canon, including the five spiritual powers. This is surely more likely to represent the original collection.
